viewNote: Default keeps every model. Chatgpt keeps only ChatGPT.
rangeNote: These scores use answers from the last {count} days. Choose All time to include every saved answer.
upgradeTitle: This model is on a higher plan
upgradeBody: Naver AI Briefing, OpenAI Luna, and Qwen API stay locked in this preview. Use ChatGPT, AI Overview, or Perplexity.
needModel: Keep at least one model. Reset filters to show every model again.
chooseBody: Claims are pulled only from the prompts you pick here, and only from answers that name a tracked brand. Write your facts first and they are checked as those claims arrive.
updatedNone: No answers in this period yet
headline: AI doesn't associate {brand} with your industry's attributes yet
subhead: What AI associates {brand} with, and where it holds ground against competitors
industryHint: Showing competitors for “{industry}”. Competitors are selected from your industry, so keep it specific for accurate results.
languageHint: The language AI answers in when we ask what your brand is known for. Changing it starts brand perception over, because the current attributes are worded in the old language.
marketHint: Where your brand competes. A national scope names national players; a city scope surfaces local ones.
mostHint: What AI reaches for when it is asked about {brand} directly. Scored 0 to 100, where 100 means the attribute always comes up first.
gapHint: Where {brand} is described differently from how it competes. This stays empty until at least four attributes are scored against competitors.
industryRequired: Enter an industry so competitors can be chosen.
industrySavedBody: Competitors stay on the Video Production Software sample. A live run rebuilds them from {industry}.
languageBody: Attributes are worded in the current language. This preview keeps the English sample and shows {language} as the answer language.
languageNote: Scores stay on the English sample until a live run rewrites the attributes in the language you picked.
scopeGlobalHint: Names players wherever the industry is discussed.
scopeNationalHint: Names national players in the country you compete in.
scopeCityHint: Surfaces local players in one city.
describesBody: Top attributes when AI is asked about {brand}
associationEmpty: {brand} has no association score for this period. Run your prompts and wait until the run finishes. A score appears when an answer names {brand} for an attribute.
associationLeaders: {brand} was not named for these attributes, so these are not {brand}'s scores. Each bar is the highest score, and the name under it is the brand the answers placed first.
shapeNoScores: None of the selected attributes have a score yet. Run your prompts and wait until the run finishes, or choose attributes that an answer already tied to a brand.
shapeBody: Market prominence, one axis per attribute
shapeEmpty: Pick at least one attribute to draw the brand shape.
banner: Perception shifts when content and PR act on it. Your plan includes unlimited seats.
compareBody: How each brand places when AI is asked about the industry, not about one brand. A higher score means the brand tends to be named earlier.
offersHidden: These phrases describe a price, a plan, or a limit, so they are not attributes: {phrases}. Attributes are saved when brand analysis finishes a prompt run. A higher score means the brand was named earlier for that attribute.
compareMissingTitle: Competitor scores are not ready yet
compareMissingBody: {brands} did not come up for these attributes. A dash means the answers did not tie that brand to the attribute.
compareMissingSteps: What to do: 1) Run your prompts. 2) Wait for the run to finish. 3) Come back here and choose “Check again”. The scores fill in on their own when the run finishes.
noBrand: No brand matches that search. Try another name.
needBrand: Keep at least one brand in the comparison.
imageTitle: Save as image is not connected
imageBody: Use Export CSV to take these numbers. An image download needs the live chart.
copiedBody: The table is on your clipboard.
downloadedBody: The file is in your downloads folder.
scaleHint: Shading runs from 0 up to the highest score in this table. The score itself is the number in the cell, so two cells in one range can differ.
sourcesBody: Where your brand places for each attribute, and the sources feeding it
sourcesHint: Every attribute AI associates with your brand, where you place against the other brands scored for it, and its top competitors. Expand a row for the sources AI used, how often, and their citation rate.
sourceLead: The pages AI cites the most about your brand, and the attributes each one feeds
sourcePreview: Showing {shown} of {total} sources in this preview. Connect live answers to load every page.
noSource: No source matches that search. Try a domain or a page title.
noAttribute: No attribute matches that search. Try another word.
noSourceFor: No page in this preview cites {attribute}. Sources appear when answers name it.
termsBody: The exact words AI used to describe your brand, how often each came up, and the attribute it was grouped into.
noTerm: No term matches that search. Try another word.
customHeatNote: Custom attributes are scored on the next brand perception run. Until then their comparison cells stay empty.
objectionsLead: The recurring arguments AI makes against you when a buyer is deciding, clustered by meaning
lockTitle: See why buyers say no to you
lockBody: Upgrade to see the arguments AI makes against your brand when a buyer is deciding, and the pages behind them.
upgradeProBody: Upgrade to Pro is not available in this preview. Objections stay locked until the workspace is on Pro.
factsEmptyBody: Claims AI makes about you are checked against the facts you write here. One statement per line.
factsReadyBody: {count} statements are saved on this page. Choose the prompts, then fact-check them.
factsLimit: Your plan covers {max} facts. Remove a line so only {max} statements remain.
factsReplace: This box already has facts. Clear it first if you want the three sample statements.
promptsBody: Claims are pulled from the prompts you pick here and checked against your facts. Your plan covers {max} prompts.
promptsFull: Your plan covers {max} prompts. Uncheck one before adding another.
writeFactsFirst: Write at least one fact on the page first. One statement per line.
checkingBody: Checking {prompts} prompts against {facts} facts. Claims show up here when an answer names {brand}. None have arrived in this preview.
manageBody: Drag terms onto an attribute to regroup, rename or delete attributes, or select clustered terms to remove them. Regrouping applies when you choose Apply changes. Renamed attributes are re-scored on the next brand perception run.
changesReady: Changes are ready. Apply them to update this page.
dragHint: Drag a term onto an attribute on the left to regroup it. Drop it on Unassigned to take it out of a group.
applyDoneBody: This page now uses the grouping you applied. A live run re-scores renamed attributes.
termsPick: Pick one term to track on its own, or several to group together.
addLimit: Your plan covers {max} custom attributes. Remove one before adding another.
nameRequired: Name the attribute before adding it.
termRequired: Pick at least one term to group into this attribute.
companyBody: Full access to every project, plus billing and member management.
inviteNeedEmail: Enter an email address to send the invite.
inviteNeedAccess: Choose a project access level before sending. No access cannot receive the invite.
inviteSentTitle: Invite is not sent from this preview
inviteSentBody: {email} would be invited once this workspace can send mail. Nothing was sent.
savedBody: It stays in this browser until you reset. A live workspace is needed to store it for the team.
tour1Body: We ask AI directly what it associates with your brand, on its own set of answers rather than the prompts you track. Your prompt choices do not shape what you see here.
tour2Body: The attributes AI reaches for when asked about your brand, each carrying an association score from 0 to 100. A bar groups several phrasings into one attribute. Hover a bar to see them.
tour3Body: Each axis is an attribute AI links to your market, scaled to the brand that leads it, so reaching the edge means leading it. The corner values carry the 0 to 100 scores.
tour4Body: We ask AI which brands lead each attribute, so this list runs wider than the competitors you track. An out-of-place brand usually means your industry is set too broad.
tour5Body: Shading runs from 0 up to the highest score in this table, and the labels are ranges for reading it. The score itself is the number in the cell, so two cells in one range can differ.
tour6Body: Rename attributes and drag terms between them so the grouping matches how you talk about your market. Regrouping applies right away, and renames re-score on the next run.
tour7Body: Open an attribute to see the pages AI cited when it described brands for that quality. One page can sit under several attributes, and Occurrences counts how often each was cited.
inviteNoProjects: This workspace has no projects yet. Create a project first, then invite people to it.
factsPlaceholder: Write one fact per line, for example: "Our plan starts at 29 € per month."
factsUnsavedNote: Not saved yet. Click "Save facts" to keep them.
factsNoSuggestion: We could not suggest facts yet. Write your own facts, one per line.
checkDoneBody: {count, plural, one {We checked your facts against # prompt.} other {We checked your facts against # prompts.}}
checkFailedBody: The fact check could not finish. Try again in a few minutes.
factsSavedBody: Your facts are saved. Pick prompts and run a check to see if AI answers match them.
industryNotSetHint: Add your industry so we compare you with the right market.
